posts.cooked:
If it’s over an hour, it ain’t “short”. (Okay, but it certainly felt short!)

Adam was clearly in a mood for this opening, which I appreciate, because I was in the opposite mood and needed cheering up. Thanks, Adam.

Space Mouse? You mean the long-lost cosmic cousin of Gun Rat???

THE ANIMEVERSE?!?! This is delightful! And since they note this is her first appearance, does that mean we’ll be seeing K.U.N.A.I. again??

Rockabilly to psychobilly, fantastic, perfect logic.

I can, of course, only speak for myself, but I feel like finding out why/how he ended up in the brig fulfills the prompt, full stop.

God, I love enemies who compliment each other the whole fight. Even better when they’re versions of the same character!

I’m glad he brought up “Audio” starting with “A”, it also bothers me lol

Cannot believe they just jumped into VC while recording. XD Classic.

posts.cooked:
So KUNAI’s art style doesn’t seem too out of place compared to Greazer or other Sentinels characters, in contrast to the Mangaverse cover we got a while back, which looked pretty distinct. Does the Mangaverse just turn everything that enters it into anime artstyle, and those characters look different when they exit that universe?

As far as a Greazer hero deck goes, I will say each expansion so far includes 5 existing hero decks + 1 new hero. Across the 3 future expansions, there are 15 existing decks remaining, and 3 major candidates for new heroes: Rambler, Fashion, and Young Legacy. So if the pattern holds, then we know all the pieces already. Though there’s no guarantee the pattern will hold, especially once we get to OblivAeon.

Maybe the teaser was more for what Greazer is doing in the RPG? He gets attached to his time-displaced crewmates and is now trying to find a way to puncture the sandwich bag and bring back La Commodora?
